items.title: [2026-07-02] Sell what you don't use — free classifieds (Image Prompt)
items.content:
Editorial classifieds hero poster for QckServe, coupon/ticket theme.

SCENE: A warm, softly-lit Indian home interior on a rainy monsoon afternoon — a tidy corner where someone is clearing out: a neatly stacked box of gently-used goods (a table lamp, books, a small speaker, folded clothes), rain visible on a window behind, calm and value-conscious mood.
SUBJECT: A friendly hand placing one item into the box, mid-gesture, natural and unposed — the everyday act of decluttering to sell.
PHONE-UI MOCKUP: A smartphone in the lower-right showing the QckServe classifieds listing screen — a single item card with a photo, a title field, an empty price field, and a bright button reading 'List free'; a small badge '₹0 commission'. Clean, modern, uncluttered app UI.
COLOUR SYSTEM: flat colour blocking, NO gradients — QckServe orange #ef6723 as the hero accent, deep charcoal #1A1A1A for contrast blocks, warm off-white paper #FCF9F8 as base, soft highlight #FFE7D8. One accent used sparingly.
LIGHTING: soft, diffused monsoon daylight from the window, gentle shadows, cosy and clean.
TYPE HIERARCHY: oversized extra-bold condensed caps headline 'SELL IT. FREE.' with a smaller Georgia-italic kicker 'the monsoon clear-out'; a coupon/ticket device showing a giant '₹0 TO LIST' with a dashed perforation and a tear-off 'ADMIT ONE SELLER' stub.
EYE FLOW: top-left logo zone → oversized headline → ₹0 coupon ticket → phone UI → wordmark 'qckserve.in' bottom.
CAMERA: 35mm editorial, shallow depth of field, eye-level, product-catalogue crispness.
PERFORMANCE LAYER: high thumb-stopping contrast, legible at small sizes, message reads even with the image compressed.
Reserve the TOP-LEFT logo zone (~140px square) empty — logo placed manually.
